I can't believe I let you talk me into coming here.|translated=1|Meevid, to Manju|}} '''Meevid''' was a [[human]] [[scavenger]] who lived during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], Meevid hiked through a [[forest]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Khofar]] along with the scavenger [[Manju]]. There, the two scavengers encountered the [[Wookiee]] [[Jedi]] [[Kelnacca]] outside of a crashed [[starship]] being used as a [[Kelnacca's shelter|shelter]] by the Jedi. Meevid drew his [[blaster]] on Kelnacca but fled after Kelnacca [[Telekinesis|Force pulled]] it out of his [[Limb|hands]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|A crashed ship! I bet there's a hyperdrive we can strip for parts.|translated=1|Manju, to Meevid|}} [[File:SneakyWookiee-RevengeJustice.png|thumb|300px|right|The scavengers were unaware of the Wookiee's approach.]] Meevid was a [[human]] [[scavenger]] active during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Meevid, along with the scavenger [[Manju]], hiked through a [[forest]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Khofar]] after being lured there by the many [[Starship|ships]] that had been caught in its dense [[Plant|vegetation]]. As Meevid complained that they were lost and that he could not believe Manju had convinced him to go there, the two scavengers came across a crashed starship, which was actually the [[Kelnacca's shelter|shelter]] of the [[Wookiee]] [[Jedi]] [[Kelnacca]]. After Manju suggested that they may be able to find a [[hyperdrive]] to strip for parts within the wreck, the scavengers noticed a sign which [[Writing|read]] "Keep Out" in [[Shyriiwook]],{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/revenge-justice-episode-guide|text="Revenge / Justice" Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} but they were unable to read it. The pair were then approached by Kelnacca, who roared at them, causing Meevid to draw his [[blaster]] and aim it at the Wookiee. In response, Kelnacca [[Telekinesis|Force pulled]] the blaster from Meevid's [[Limb|hands]] and broke it in two, causing the scavengers to flee. ==Personality and traits== Meevid was a human with [[Color|graying]] brown [[hair]] and a beard, brown [[eye]]s, and light skin. He was cowardly and fled from Kelnacca. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|What does it say?''"
"''How should I know?|translated=1|Meevid and Manju, after noticing a sign written in Shyriiwook|}} Meevid spoke [[Huttese]] and could not read [[Wookiee script|Shyriiwook]]. ==Equipment== Meevid wore brown [[clothing]] and a black headband. He carried a blaster and wore equipment on his back. ==Behind the scenes== ===Overview=== {{Quote|It's a different feeling altogether. The pure excitement. And again, I'm jumping around, but the bit that really hit for me was when I went in for the costume fitting. Because it felt like a ''Star Wars'' costume. We tried on a few different things and then it looked so cool. And this is before they've aged it up and dirtied it up and all that.|Scroobius Pip|{{Apple|subdomain=podcasts|url=us/podcast/the-acolyte-h-o-t-d-special-w-chris-distraction/id929136539?i=1000662459369|text=The Acolyte & H.O.T.D. Special (w/Chris) • Distraction Pieces Podcast with Scroobius Pip #577}}}} [[File:ScavengerStoryboard2-JimCornish.png|thumb|200px|right|Storyboard by Jim Cornish]] Meevid first appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]]," the second episode of the [[2024]] [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]],'' which aired on [[June 4]], 2024.{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} He was portrayed by [[Scroobius Pip]]. Meevid was identified in ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', a [[2025]] reference book by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. The Khofar scenes including Meevid were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],{{Lucasfilm|url=news/lucasfilm-on-location-the-acolyte|text=Lucasfilm on Location: ''The Acolyte''}} [[Wikipedia:England|England]].{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} Storyboards of the sequence including the scavenger were created by [[Jim Cornish]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.jdcillustration.com/the-acolyte|text=The Acolyte|work=[https://www.jdcillustration.com/home JDC Illustration Ltd]|archivedate=20250320040832}} Pip was excited to be in ''[[Star Wars]]'' and was "jumping around" because of it. He was particularly excited about his costume, which he thought was "cool" and said "felt like a ''Star Wars'' costume. After trying on multiple costumes, his outfit was aged up and dirtied. During one take, Pip hit his shin on a rock on set and then had to pretend he was alright for the remainder of the takes. Kelnacca pulling away the scavenger's blaster was done by having someone stand on a ladder and pull it with string. It took multiple takes to get the angle correct, and during one take, the blaster was broken and had to be repaired. It was important to Pip that he did not meet Kelnacca actor [[Joonas Suotamo]] without his costume on, so he refused to go in communal areas on set. According to Pip, Director [[Leslye Headland]] said that the scene was the best shot in the episode. ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' |storyboards= File:ScavengerStoryboard1-JimCornish.png|Storyboard, Jim Cornish File:ScavengerStoryboard2-JimCornish.png|Storyboard, Jim Cornish File:ScavengerStoryboard3-JimCornish.png|Storyboard, Jim Cornish File:ScavengerStoryboard4-JimCornish.png|Storyboard, Jim Cornish File:ScavengerStoryboard5-JimCornish.png|Storyboard, Jim Cornish |concept= |digital= |in-progress= }} ===Auditions and dialogue=== {{Quote|…It's a made-up language. But no, the stresses, the way you emphasize things, the stretching out certain bits is all established in the language.|Scroobius Pip|}} [[File:ScroobiusPip.png|thumb|250px|left|Meevid was portrayed by Scroobius Pip.]] Pip auditioned three times for multiple characters, including both scavengers, and said he believed the other roles he auditioned for were cut. Pip had to do a self-tape audition for the role while he had [[Wikipedia:COVID-19|COVID-19]], and because he was isolating, could not have someone else read lines with him. However, because he was auditioning for both characters in the scene, Pip recorded audio for both roles and then combined them into a single tape, which he believed made his audition stand out. Although the auditions were done in English, the final scene was done in Huttese, so Pip was given a [[Wikipedia:Dialect coach|dialect coach]] two weeks before the scene was filmed. Pip had to focus on stressing, emphasizing, and stretching out certain parts of the dialogue. Pip had difficulty learning his part, so his dialect coach suggested he turn it into a song or chant. Pip then spent an afternoon in his kitchen chanting his dialogue to remember it and then later tightened up the exact wording. After doing a number of takes in Huttese, a couple takes of the scene were done in English as a backup. Pip thought it would have been a shame if the scene had been done in English because it had been "cool" to learn the lines in Huttese and added that he no longer knew the English lines because of how long it had been since he auditioned. Pip originally had a line that was not initially used when filming the scene. However, when Pip came back a year later to rerecord his lines, he was asked to scream or make noise as he ran away, and he used the line that had been cut, which was saying "run away" in Huttese. His Huttese dialogue was written by Hidalgo,{{Bluesky|infinata.bsky.social|post/3kvafccgibc2d|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Enough time has passed to post this. "I wrote Huttese dialog for Scroobius Pip" is something I would never have expected to be able to say as a kid.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/pNJ3l}} a member of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]].{{StarWarsShow|GvT2F1j-SvA|Pablo Hidalgo Extended Interview|sw_url=video/pablo-hidalgo-extended-interview}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Meevid}} *{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|229|Star Wars: The Acolyte Companion|''Star Wars: The Acolyte'' Companion}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Meevid}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Meevid |fr=Meevid |ka=მივიდი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Scavengers]]
